audit.whatIsWrong: Rated TRICKY 7/10 while the data says the opposite: 54.77% over 2912 games and a packet level chart that gives Galio five of seven rows.
audit.why: Wind Wall only answers the Q; Justice Punch and Shield of Durand's taunt are not projectiles and pass straight through it, so Galio keeps his engage in a lane he is already winning. Yasuo's real window is his first crit item.
audit.corrected: diff -> FAVOURED, diffRating -> 5/10, tone -> the favoured colour, with breakdown.difficulty and the final rating line updated to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer rows disagreed with the content layer. phases[].side read Yasuo, Yasuo, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Yasuo against win[] of Skill, Galio, Galio, Galio, Galio, Yasuo, Galio, and every why was the generic Galio template regardless.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is identical to the content layer, so the full layer is the broken one. Spikes: level 3 (Justice Punch catches Sweeping Blade), level 6 both ways (your knockups feed Last Breath), his first crit item, then your two-item tankiness.
audit.corrected: All seven sides moved onto the packet/content verdicts with matched ratings and rewritten whys, proposed as one atomic group. win[] needs no edits — it already holds the correct values.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single decisive interaction was never stated: Wind Wall blocks projectiles ONLY, so it deletes Winds of War but does nothing to Justice Punch or the taunt. The page treated Wind Wall as a blanket 'hold everything' clock.
audit.why: Yasuo W: 'Creates a moving wall that blocks all enemy projectiles for 4 seconds', 25/23/21/19/17. Galio Q carries the projectile flag; E is a dash-knockup and W a 275-range taunt, neither of which is a projectile.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns, Do's and trading now say the wall eats the Q and nothing else — walk in behind it rather than waiting it out. Also stated: your own knockups (Justice Punch, Hero's Entrance) are Last Breath triggers.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Wind Wall is 25/23/21/19/17 for 4 seconds and Sweeping Blade recharges on a 0.5s-to-0.1s timer — those two numbers are the whole spacing puzzle.
audit.corrected: Both written in, plus Shield of Durand's 18s at rank 1.

audit.corrected: Both rewritten to match their titles, using the 4000-unit R range and Justice Punch's 11s cooldown.

edits.before: Best wave: a Q-cleared middle wave that keeps your R timer flexible — Galio waves are about being free to leave. Worst wave: a hard-shoved wave when your bot lane is fighting — the R you couldn't channel is the fight your team lost. Crash timing: shove with a destination in mind; mid waves are bus tickets, not chores.
edits.after: Best wave: a middle wave you can leave — Yasuo shoves fast with Steel Tempest, so match his clear and keep the R timer free. Worst wave: a wave crashed under his tower, where Sweeping Blade chains off the minions straight onto you. Crash timing: crash before you roam; Wind Wall is 25s at rank 1 and it cannot follow you to another lane.

notes: Two judgement calls worth knowing about. (1) I flipped the matchup from TRICKY 7/10 to FAVOURED 5/10 on the strength of a 54.77% win rate over 2912 games plus a packet chart giving Galio five of seven rows; tone was moved to the favoured colour and both rating lines updated so nothing contradicts. (2) The full-layer chart disagreed with the content layer on all seven rows and was realigned to the content/packet values, whys and ratings rewritten in the same group. The interaction the page had never stated is that Wind Wall blocks projectiles only — Winds of War dies to it, Justice Punch and the taunt do not, which is the difference between waiting the wall out and walking in behind it. packet.suspectNames flagged 'Use Shield of Durand' in wants.you[3]; the name is correct and was left alone, though that line's phrase 'windwall-protected all-ins' is loose — Wind Wall protects him from your projectiles, it does not protect his all-in. Left as-is rather than reshaping a line I could not fit in band.
